# cdemo-misc

Synthetic C structs, group `misc`. Generated by `tools/gen/cstruct2pack.py` from
`tools/gen/cstruct/cdemo.json` (run by `tools/gen/cdemo-run.sh`); do not edit by hand.

## Message convention

A message is a 4-byte demo header, then the struct its id names.

| Header field | Bits | Line |
|---|---|---|
| `sync` | 0-7 | `when` 165 (common) |
| `id` | 8-15 | `when` per kind: the message id |
| `size` | 16-31 | `when` per kind: the size of the message struct |

## Kinds

| Kind | Id | Struct | Bytes | Lines |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stat` | 2 | `stat_t` | 156 | 9 |

The payload is the struct as the compiler lays it out under `#pragma pack(1)`: the
members one after another with no padding, little-endian, as the test's config states. A nested struct is
flattened (`a.b`); an array of up to 64 elements is one key per element (`_0`, `_1`,
...); a longer one is a `group` with a fixed count. A `char` array of up to 255 bytes
is `ascii` text.

## Shared-model keys

None. No struct of this group states a WGS 84 position in degrees. Every field is a
raw key of module `cdemo`.

## Not mapped, and why

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| Enumerations | carried as integers |
| `DID_BAD` (id 3, `bad_t`) | its struct holds bit-fields |
| `DID_MISSING` (id 4, `nope_t`) | its type is not declared |

## Vectors

`vectors/gen-rt-<kind>.json`: a round trip per kind with every field set, values chosen by
the generator and packed by its own serializer from the layout. `gen-x-*` convert to
geojson, `gen-err-*` are a short message and an id of no kind. 3 vector files.
